findings.description: The serial port name is hardcoded as 'COM8'.
The code reads all available data from the serial port and emits it without any validation or sanitization.
If the port fails to open, the code only logs the error.
Logging the port name and error string may leak sensitive information.
Anyone using this class can open and read from the serial port.
